scenes.tts: You need three celery stalks with leaves, three clear glasses, and blue or red food colouring.
scenes.narration: You need three celery stalks with leaves, three clear glasses, and blue or red food colouring.

scenes.tts: Fill each glass with about five centimetres of water. Stir in fifteen to twenty drops of colouring per glass. An adult trims the bottom of each stalk. Stand them in a bright spot, out of direct sun.

items.text: Stand in bright spot, no direct sun

scenes.narration: Fill each glass with about five centimetres of water. Stir in fifteen to twenty drops of colouring per glass. An adult trims the bottom of each stalk. Stand them in a bright spot, out of direct sun.

scenes.tts: Check after about four hours. Most often, coloured lines show along the stalk. Overnight usually gives the clearest result, and the cut end shows a row of coloured dots.

items.text: Next day: a row of dots

scenes.narration: Check after about four hours. Most often, coloured lines show along the stalk. Overnight usually gives the clearest result, and the cut end shows a row of coloured dots.

scenes.tts: Stay nearby while the coloured water is out. An adult does all the cutting.
